entries.cccef861e071f016: Its management philosophy states: 'We contribute to society by devoting our utmost sincerity to our daily activities and by being sincere in all we do.' Its vision for the future is to contribute to customers' happy dietary lives through the pursuit of deliciousness and health and through safe and secure foods. The three-year medium-term management plan starting April 2026 (through March 31, 2029) sets 5 basic policies: 'Creating new customer value,' 'Reforming the revenue structure,' 'Expanding business domains,' 'Developing human resources' and 'Contributing to a sustainable society,' and targets consolidated revenue of ¥255 billion for the fiscal year ended March 2029, the final year of the plan.
entries.ce4b11a58ac9be30: With 11 own plants nationwide, from Hokkaido to Kyushu, together with manufacturing subsidiaries such as Toda Foods Co., Ltd. and Torak Co., Ltd., it has a structure for manufacturing processed foods nationwide. In the meat business too, subsidiaries such as Marudai Meat Co., Ltd. and Meat Supply Co., Ltd. handle processing and sales, and its strength lies in being able to carry out everything from manufacturing to sales within the group.
